en: A sepia-toned interior scene showing a crafts exhibition or shop. A man in a suit stands beside a table covered with a white cloth, displaying numerous inlaid wooden boxes. Around the table are intricately carved and inlaid wooden stools, small tables, and decorative furniture with geometric and arabesque patterns. On the back wall hang woven carpets or kilims with bold geometric motifs. Framed relief panels with horsemen and other scenes line the walls, and a portrait of a uniformed man with epaulettes is displayed above. A card with the number 24 identifies the stand.
